milestone: RA3 — production-safe cutover planning and guardrails
objective: Provide an exact, bounded, rollback-safe production introduction path for RA2 hot/cold retention without mutating legacy retained_acquisition.db in place.

accepted_criteria_for_ra3.replay_correctness_preserved: RA2 replay-equivalence checks pass on fixture and bounded synthetic windows
accepted_criteria_for_ra3.no_silent_evidence_loss: All production-path artifacts emitted with deterministic digestable identity and archival outcomes
accepted_criteria_for_ra3.growth_capability: Projected storage growth bounded to <= 1 GiB/day under RA2 budget + reserve gates (evidence, not assumptions)
accepted_criteria_for_ra3.disk_reserve_respected: free-space gates identical to RA1/RA2 policy and verified at each phase transition
accepted_criteria_for_ra3.writer_compatibility: Existing production writer path remains active until RA4 explicit authorization

legacy_writer.immutability_guard: no in-place migration or schema edits

new_writer.destination: new retained acquisition path designed for hot/cold split
new_writer.ordering: archive-before-retire ordering required per acquisition + correlation lineage
new_writer.rollback: single flag toggle to disable new writer; all production reads remain on legacy path

actions: run bounded RA0/RA1/RA2 evidence locally and record artifacts
confirm production reserved disk and reserve gates are above RA1 minimum
freeze execution artifact identities and include commit hashes in handoff
enable new writer only with explicit no-op sink and bounded telemetry
emit deterministic RA2 hot-row digests and full replay digests for diffing
acceptance: no production schema or file writes in 61GB DB
no increased write latency above defined service budget
sampled replay diff hash continuity for all mirrored rows in bounded window

actions: run new path with full write + legacy path concurrently
compare bounded replay outputs for identical acquisition identities
record deterministic mismatch report with artifact identity, artifact digests, response signatures
acceptance: no silent drop in acquisition IDs for bounded windows
replay outputs match by defined canonical signature

actions: keep legacy writer on, new writer in readiness state only
enforce storage reserve and hotstore cap on both systems
hold if any critical guard fails
acceptance: daily retention budget and reserve gates observed

evidence: deterministic preflight replay digest from RA2 fixture checks
artifact-level canonical signatures compared for bounded windows
one acquisition identity per acquisition preserved
per-correlation and per-mint cap behavior matches policy
operational budget and observed hot-row byte measurements

required_controls: legacy path remains authoritative source of truth until RA4

required_for_go: All RA3 preflight artifacts generated and reviewed
No production writes enabled to retained_acquisition.db outside current legacy path
Signed human decision for RA3->RA4 authorization
must_hold_without_go: anything that triggers full DB rewrite
any evidence loss risk or replay divergence in bounded windows

next_step: RA4 only after explicit authorization, with RA3 artifacts linked in handoff
